title: introduce-observability-railway-and-cost-deblur-fanout
author: Priya Kaur
description: Motivation: large multi-stage inference pipelines (fast path fallback to slower models, prefix replays, and multi-tenant routing) make per-token cost attribution opaque and introduce observability backpressure when telemetry fanout is naive. This PR introduces two coordinated subsystems: 1) Signal Railway: a lightweight router that normalizes, deduplicates and routes observability artifacts (metrics, traces, logs, billing events) to downstream consumers with backpressure and bounded buffering; 2) Cost Deblur: a post-processing reattribution step that reconciles overlapping token emissions across fallback/replica invocations and attributes cost to the originating invocation via provenance anchors. Scope: implements runtime adapter for emitting canonical railway envelopes, a small in-memory fanout queue with per-tenant QoS, the Cost Deblur service that consumes compact envelopes and emits corrected billing events, a new Signal Railway dashboard, and alert tuning to reduce billing-noise churn. Checklist: [x] Design doc linked (Linear ENG-4218) [x] End-to-end integration test [x] Performance microbench for fanout latency [x] Dashboard and runbook updates [x] Add feature flag (obs.signal_railway.enabled) Changeset summary: commits: - Add canonical railway envelope schema and runtime shim - Implement railway fanout worker with per-tenant QoS and bounded buffers - Add deblur service with provenance anchor matching and probabilistic eviction - Expose telemetry metrics: railway.queue_depth, railway.dispatch_latency_ms, deblur.rewrites, deblur.unmatched_events - Add Signal Railway Grafana dashboard and Alert: Billing deblur mismatch rate (>0.5% sustained) - Tests: unit tests for anchor matching, integration test with synthetic replaybench - Feature flag gate and rollout plan Affected files (high-level): observability/railway/envelope.go, observability/railway/worker.go, observability/deblur/service.go, telemetry/metrics/registry.go, dashboards/signal-railway.json, docs/observability/railway.md, tests/telemetry/test_deblur.py, ci/replaybench/README.md, ci/workflows/replaybench.yml.
Why it's different: instead of only adding extra telemetry points we introduce a first-class fanout router to protect collectors from load spikes and a corrective pipeline to reconcile billing artifacts — both aimed squarely at production stability during model fallback scenarios.
